component.name: hps-system
component.description: Host Provisioning Service - bash PXE/DHCP/TFTP/HTTP provisioning platform

properties.name: hps:versioning
properties.value: Component versions track the debian:trixie-slim base image suite and are resolved at build time (no pinning); CVE scans should resolve against the trixie suite. See rules/release-workflow.md SBOM dependency rule.

properties.name: hps:nixos-versioning
properties.value: NixOS node components are taken from nixpkgs branch nixos-26.05 as locked at build time (the builder writes the nixpkgs revision into each image boot.json and the pin name). flake.lock is not yet committed; CVE scans resolve against the pinned nixpkgs revision of the served pin, not a version recorded here.

properties.name: hps:scope-phase-1
properties.value: Phase 1 close-out (2026-11-09): adds chrony on the IPS and the NixOS node/audit image component set. Compute components (libvirt, QEMU, OVMF) and storage services beyond ZFS userland are not yet in the images and are not listed.
